sentences.text: A complete genome sequence of Megamonas funiformis was reported for a strain isolated from the faeces of a healthy Japanese person, with a 2,310,709 base pair circular chromosome.
In a study of 22 women with inactive systemic lupus erythematosus and 20 healthy volunteers, the genus Megamonas was significantly enriched in the lupus group.
The authors suggested that increased Megamonas funiformis abundance, elevated plasma zonulin and higher sodium intake may contribute to reduced C3 complement levels in those women.
An in silico profiling study of bacteria associated with osteoporosis or low bone mineral density reported that Megamonas funiformis showed one of the strongest predicted gut-bone axis signals.
